column2: No. It's him, right over there. We're traveling together...{wait}{clear}
Huh? Where?{wait}{clear}
...Huh? Wait, can ordinary people not see angels?{wait}{clear}

Oh, stop it, there's nobody there. You were drinking before you came here again, weren't you?{wait}{clear}If you can drink at some other place, there's no reason you can't drink here with us.{wait}{clear}
...Oh, well.{wait}{clear}All right, bring us more. Let's drink, everyone!{wait}{clear}
Sigh... He seems to be a troublesome man...{wait}{clear}Let's leave him be and go back first...{wait}{clear}
Angel... are you there?{wait}{clear}
Why did you go home?{wait}{clear}Was it perhaps a little too stimulating for an angel?{wait}{clear}
Going a little too wild...{n}
Oops, my apologies. Are you angry?{wait}{clear}
No, I was just a little appalled.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha, you're harsh. But this is the kind of man I am.{wait}{clear}
If that doesn't suit you, then please never bother with me again.{wait}{clear}Well, I'm sleepy now.{wait}{clear}Come by again if you want to. Good night.{wait}{clear}
I don't think it's very good to go so wild.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha, you're so serious.{wait}{clear}
What, over something like that? Life is short. It's a waste not to enjoy it, don't you think?{wait}{clear}
Well, if you don't like me, there's nothing to be done. I have no intention of changing to suit you.{wait}{clear}Now, if you need anything, come by again. Good night.{wait}{clear}
Ah, it's you, Angel. I'm just about to step out for a bit.{wait}{clear}If there's something you want to talk about, please make it tomorrow.{wait}{clear}
Ah! Rocus...! Sigh... He's gone...{wait}{clear}
Quietly follow him{n}
Don't follow him{n}
I wonder where he's going... Let's try following him.{wait}{clear}
We've been waiting for you all this time. Why didn't you come for so long?{wait}{clear}
Hm? Oh, I've just been a little busy. Let's have fun tonight.{wait}{clear}
Really?{wait}{clear}Then, Rocus-samaaa, let's drink some more!{wait}{clear}
Yes, bring more! It's on me, everyone, enjoy yourselves!{wait}{clear}
Rocus... I wonder if he's all right...{wait}{clear}
I can more or less guess where he's going... but will he be all right...?{wait}{clear}
Rocus's Pal
Hey, Rocus. Somebody's here wanting to see you.{wait}{clear}
Who?{wait}{clear}
That guy over there. Seems his crowd calls him "Viper."{wait}{clear}
Hmm, a venomous snake, eh? What a brave nickname.{wait}{clear}
Word is he's an ace gambler, famous all around the Six Kingdoms.{wait}{clear}
Interesting. I'll go meet him.{wait}{clear}
Hey, Rocus. I've been waiting.{wait}{clear}
What do you want with me, Mr. Viper?{wait}{clear}
Nothing. Just showing my face.{wait}{clear}
My name's Clarence Langerack. And like the nickname says, I'm Viper.{wait}{clear}
I don't suppose I need to give you my name.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I know it. Rocus Las Flores, the womanizing delinquent priest and king of debt.{wait}{clear}
Hmph. Well, you can leave out the "delinquent" and "debt" parts.{wait}{clear}
Anyway, today's just a hello.{wait}{clear}
Next time we meet, I want to play you.{wait}{clear}
